content.text: Integration testing verifies that components work together correctly, catching issues that unit tests miss at the boundaries between systems, services, and data stores.

items: Integration Testing — API testing, database testing, contract testing, and end-to-end strategies
API & Contract Testing — REST/GraphQL/gRPC testing, Pact contracts, OpenAPI validation, and service virtualization
Database Integration Testing — Testcontainers, migration testing, fixture management, and repository testing patterns
Database & E2E Testing — Testcontainers, Playwright/Cypress E2E, visual regression testing, and Page Object Model
